QUOTE: `app/actions/websocket/channel.ts:463` | Nothing extra | If the user is viewing this channel, kick them out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`; then remove the current user from the channel locally.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels are not viewable, the websocket handler kicks the user out of the current channel and removes them from it. `archiveChannel` likewise removes membership in that case, and when viewable it sets `delete_at` so the channel stays visible as archived.
